description: This file defines classes and methods related to the Torch Mobile JIT compilation unit and module, including function registration, method retrieval, and module metadata management.

classes.name: CompilationUnit
classes.description: Represents a compilation unit containing a list of methods/functions for the JIT interpreter.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents a Torch Mobile model, including data, metadata, and associated compilation unit.

classes.name: ModuleInfo
classes.description: Holds metadata about a module such as bytecode version, operator version, and function/type names.

methods.name: register_function
methods.description: Registers a new function within the compilation unit.

methods.name: methods
methods.description: Returns the list of methods in the compilation unit.

methods.name: find_function
methods.description: Finds a function by its qualified name.

methods.name: get_method
methods.description: Retrieves a method by name from the module.

methods.name: run_method
methods.description: Executes a method with provided arguments.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Runs the 'forward' method of the module.

methods.name: find_method
methods.description: Finds a method by its basename.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the module.

methods.name: slots
methods.description: Returns the slots of the underlying object.

methods.name: _ivalue
methods.description: Returns the internal IValue object.

methods.name: parameters
methods.description: Returns the parameters of the module.

methods.name: named_parameters
methods.description: Returns named parameters of the module.

methods.name: get_forward_method_debug_info
methods.description: Provides debug info for the forward method.

methods.name: getModuleHierarchy
methods.description: Returns the module hierarchy as a string.

methods.name: getCallStack
methods.description: Returns the call stack as a string.

methods.name: train
methods.description: Sets the module in training mode.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Sets the module in evaluation mode.

methods.name: is_training
methods.description: Checks if the module is in training mode.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns the module's metadata.

methods.name: setMetadata
methods.description: Sets the module's metadata.

methods.name: get_methods
methods.description: Returns the list of methods.

methods.name: attr
methods.description: Accesses an attribute or constant by name.

methods.name: setDebugTable
methods.description: Sets the debug table for the module.

methods.name: getDebugTable
methods.description: Retrieves the debug table.

methods.name: setHasDebugHandles
methods.description: Enables or disables debug handles.

methods.name: hasDebugHandles
methods.description: Checks if debug handles are enabled.

methods.name: compilation_unit
methods.description: Returns the associated compilation unit.

methods.name: set_delete_memory
methods.description: Sets memory to be deleted when the module is destroyed.

methods.name: set_min_operator_version
methods.description: Sets the minimum operator version.

methods.name: min_operator_version
methods.description: Gets the minimum operator version.

methods.name: set_bytecode_version
methods.description: Sets the bytecode version.

methods.name: bytecode_version
methods.description: Gets the bytecode version.
